title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic details Scion, its in-house Git replacement for a high-volume monorepo
bullets.summary: Daily monorepo merges grew from ~2,500 (May) to 30,000+ (Sept); seven engineers built Scion plus a review tool, Antique, in five months, and Anthropic claims a 200x smaller VCS infrastructure footprint (vendor-reported).
bullets.how: The Construct: a data point that agent-heavy workflows outgrow Git assumptions; relevant if swarm merges into shared repos (e.g., hartley-command) start colliding. PRAGMA: talking point on infra limits for agent-scale code generation. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Anthropic Frontier Red Team warns small open-weight models may soon self-replicate on commercial IoT hardware (Oct 13)
bullets.summary: A 9B model ran inference on 8 of 9 tested device types; the team says autonomous replication could be months away (vendor research, not independently verified).
bullets.how: The Construct: reinforces sandboxed, least-privilege agents with outbound-network allowlists. PRAGMA: security-posture selling point for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Anthropic pitches investors at ~$1.8-2T valuation; public IPO filing reportedly expected ~Oct 25
bullets.summary: Leaked prospectus figures (secondhand via Yahoo Finance) reportedly show a large operating loss and $518B in compute obligations.
bullets.how: The Construct: vendor-concentration/pricing risk to watch as Anthropic goes public; keep model routing portable. PRAGMA: likely client question (vendor stability). Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Mistral Large 4 preview (Oct 6): 1T-parameter multimodal MoE, open weights due Oct 27
bullets.summary: 49B active parameters; Mistral calls it the strongest open-weight model from the US or Europe (vendor claim). Not 24h-new, but weights land in under two weeks (via Techmeme snapshot).
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate self-hostable worker for cheap high-volume tasks once weights ship. PRAGMA: open-weight/data-residency option for clients. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

praxis_lesson: Agent-capable systems are scaling faster than the infrastructure and trust assumptions around them (source control, device security, vendor finances), so design the fleet for portability and containment: sandboxed least-privilege agents, swappable model providers, and coordination paths that don't assume human-speed commits.
